title: Continuous-Time Constrained Linear Quadratic Regulator for Switched Linear Systems
summary: Switched systems, characterized by a family of subsystems governed by a switching rule, widely apply to complex real-world scenarios. However, their inherent switching dynamics pose significant challenges in phase analysis and control design. To address these challenges, we propose a framework for solving the Continuous-Time Constrained Linear Quadratic Regulator (CT-CLQR) problem for switched linear systems.
